project: BOPET 双向拉伸聚酯薄膜产线

machines.note: 段 1 · 蓝。整条线第一台，负责把切片含水降到 30~50 ppm。提示词里 `three clamp-ring flange joints` 和 `two vertical molecular-sieve cartridges` 是防翻车句——不加这两句，模型会给你一个普通水泥筒仓。标注名：**Drying Tower / 原料干燥塔**。
machines.subject_3d:
an industrial PET chip drying tower unit for a biaxial film line: a tall cylindrical
stainless-steel hopper with a conical discharge bottom and three clamp-ring flange joints,
standing on a square welded frame; a smaller fluidized-bed pre-crystallizer box attached at
the left with a blower and insulated duct feeding the hopper; a compact desiccant dehumidifier
cabinet beside it containing two vertical molecular-sieve cartridges, a process-air heater and
insulated flexible hoses running to the hopper top; a small control cabinet with one blank
screen; a few rigid vertical process pipes with hand-wheel valves.
Accent color: deep blue (#2E6BE6) on the frame, hand-wheel valves and a few small indicator
lights, occupying less than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same drying tower drawn as a patent-style sectional line diagram — cylindrical
hopper with flange rings, fluidized-bed crystallizer box, blower, dehumidifier cabinet with two
molecular-sieve cartridges, heater, interconnecting ducts with valves, control cabinet.
machines.extra_negative: cement silo, grain silo, water tank, generic pressure vessel

machines.note: 段 1 · 蓝。三台喂料机并列、共用一个混合漏斗，是"配方精度"的物理落点。`loss-in-weight` 与 `load-cell weighing platform` 必须写，否则模型画成普通料斗。
machines.subject_3d:
a bank of three loss-in-weight gravimetric feeders mounted side by side on one shared
stainless-steel frame: each has a trapezoidal stainless hopper with a hinged lid, a short screw
feeder barrel underneath driven by a compact servo motor and gearbox, and a load-cell weighing
platform under the hopper; all three discharge into a common conical mixing manifold below,
which connects to one short flexible hose; a small touchscreen on a swing arm at the right.
Accent color: deep blue (#2E6BE6) on the frame and a few indicator lights, occupying less than
10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same gravimetric feeder bank drawn as a patent-style line diagram — three
trapezoidal hoppers, screw feeder barrels, servo gearmotors, load-cell platforms, common mixing
manifold, flexible outlet hose, control touchscreen on arm.
machines.extra_negative: cement hopper, sand blasting hopper, single hopper on legs

machines.note: 段 2 · 青。全系列最重要的一张。`horizontal barrel ... with five hinged heating-jacket covers in a row` 是它的识别特征（一排铰链式保温罩），`vacuum vent port on top` 是排气式挤出机的标志。**必须写 `long and low`**，否则模型会画成注塑机那种高胖机身。标注名：**Single-Screw Extruder / 单螺杆挤出机**。
machines.subject_3d:
a large single-screw plastics extruder for film production: a horizontal barrel about
8 meters long with five hinged heating-jacket covers in a row along its length, a bulky
rectangular gearbox and a TEFC drive motor at the right end, a stainless feed hopper with a
slide gate on the left top, a vacuum vent port on top of the barrel with a small condenser, two
rigid insulated melt pipes leaving the discharge end, the whole unit mounted on a low fabricated
steel base with anchor bolts; proportional character: long and low, roughly 6 times longer than
it is tall.
Accent color: teal (#0FA3A3) on the barrel jacket covers and the base frame, occupying less
than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same extruder drawn as a patent-style line diagram — horizontal barrel with
segmented heating jackets, gearbox, drive motor, feed hopper with slide gate, vacuum vent with
condenser, two melt pipes at the discharge end, low base frame.
machines.extra_negative: injection molding machine, 3D printer, pipe extruder, CNC lathe

machines.note: 段 3 · 绿。**本系列第一个剖切件**。核心是 `quarter-section revealing the stacked circular filter discs`——不剖开，模型只会给你两个圆柱罐子，看不出是过滤器。`hydraulic cylinder ... for screen transfer` 交代"不停机换网"这个动作。标注名：**Continuous Screen Changer / 连续换网熔体过滤器**。
machines.subject_3d:
a dual-chamber continuous screen changer melt filter: two vertical cylindrical pressure
housings side by side, each with a heavy bolted flange head and heating-jacket bands, joined by
thick insulated melt pipes with a gear-pump block between them; the front housing is cut away
with a clean quarter-section revealing the stacked circular filter discs and a sintered-metal
filter pack inside; a hydraulic cylinder and sliding screen-transfer mechanism at the rear; two
pressure gauges on top of each housing.
Accent color: green (#2FA84F) on the flange rings and gauge bezels, occupying less than 10% of
the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same screen changer drawn as a patent-style sectional line diagram — two
vertical cylindrical housings with bolted flange heads, one shown in quarter-section with stacked
circular filter discs and sintered filter pack, hydraulic transfer cylinder at the rear,
connecting melt pipes, gear pump block, pressure gauges; hidden passages in dashed lines.
machines.extra_negative: two plain cylindrical tanks, water filter housing, gas cylinder

machines.name_zh: 衣架型 T 型模头
machines.note: 段 4 · 琥珀。**第二个剖切件**。`coat-hanger-shaped manifold` 这个词是灵魂——衣架型流道是这个零件的名字来源，不写就会画成一块铁疙瘩。`a row of thermal-bolt actuators evenly spaced along the top edge` 是自动调厚度的执行机构。标注名：**Hanger-Type Flat Die / 衣架型 T 型模头**。
machines.subject_3d:
a hanger-type flat film extrusion die: a massive rectangular steel body about 2.5
meters wide and 0.4 meters tall with a row of evenly spaced thermal-bolt actuators along its top
edge, each with a small heater cartridge and a thin wire; the front face is cut away with a
clean half-section revealing the internal coat-hanger-shaped manifold channel narrowing toward an
adjustable die lip at the bottom; the die rests in a rigid support cradle with adjustment screws;
an insulated melt feed pipe enters the center of the body.
Accent color: amber (#E08A00) on the die-lip cover plate and actuator caps, occupying less than
10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same flat die drawn as a patent-style sectional line diagram — rectangular die
body with a row of thermal-bolt actuators on top, half-section showing the internal
coat-hanger-shaped manifold narrowing to the die lip, support cradle with adjustment screws,
central melt feed pipe; internal channel in dashed lines.
machines.extra_negative: solid steel block, extrusion screw, hydraulic press platen

machines.note: 段 4 · 琥珀。`chrome-plated chill roll ... mirror-finish` 是它的视觉标签（一定要有镜面高光），`electrostatic pinning bar with a thin electrode wire` 是静电吸附——这两句缺一个，模型就会画成造纸机的烘缸。标注名：**Chill Roll + Electrostatic Pinning / 冷鼓与静电吸附**。
machines.subject_3d:
a film casting unit: one large chrome-plated chill roll about 1.2 meters in diameter
and 3 meters face width with a mirror-finish polished surface, carried in a heavy side frame
with a drive motor; an electrostatic pinning bar with a thin electrode wire held on an adjustable
arm above the roll, connected by a cable to a high-voltage generator box; a die support bracket
above the roll; a compact thickness-gauge frame downstream; a stripper roll and two idler rolls
near the bottom; a rotary cooling-water union at the roll end.
Accent color: amber (#E08A00) on the roll end cover and the high-voltage box, occupying less
than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same casting unit drawn as a patent-style line diagram — large chill roll in
side frames, electrostatic pinning bar with electrode wire on an adjustable arm, high-voltage
generator, die support bracket, thickness-gauge frame, stripper and idler rolls, rotary water
union.
machines.extra_negative: paper machine dryer drum, conveyor roller, water tank

machines.note: 段 5 · 紫。识别特征是 `two groups of large chrome-plated heating rolls`，慢辊组与快辊组分列两侧形成 S 形穿膜。`left group rotating slower and the right group faster` 这句模型未必懂，但会强化"两组不同"的结构暗示。标注名：**MDO Roll Stand / 纵向拉伸机组**。
machines.subject_3d:
a machine-direction orientation roll stand: two groups of large chrome-plated heating
rolls, about sixteen rolls each 0.4 meters in diameter, arranged in an S-wrap web path along a
common frame, with the left group on closer shaft spacing and the right group spaced wider, each
roll driven from the far side by its own servo gearmotor; a continuous thin translucent film web
threaded through the rolls; two infrared heater hoods above the gap between the groups; insulated
side panels and a compact fabricated frame.
Accent color: violet (#7A5AF8) on the frame uprights and the heater hood edges, occupying less
than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same MDO roll stand drawn as a patent-style line diagram — two groups of large
heating rolls in an S-wrap path, individual servo gearmotors, infrared heater hoods, threaded
film web shown as a thin line, frame with side panels.
machines.extra_negative: conveyor belt frame, printing press roller stack, calendar stack

machines.note: 段 5 · 紫。**第三个剖切件，也是最难画的一台**。`two endless chain rails diverging in a V shape` 必须写——这是横向拉伸的全部机制；不写，模型一定画成隧道炉或传送带。`with clip units gripping both edges of a wide translucent film web that widens as it travels` 交代"膜在变宽"。图上只画 25~30 m 的一截（示意图不按真实 100 m 画）。标注名：**Tenter Frame (TDO) / 横向拉伸拉幅机**。
machines.subject_3d:
a tenter frame for transverse film stretching, drawn as a 30-meter-long machine: a long
insulated oven housing with hinged access panels and circular recirculation fan housings along its
side, visibly divided into preheat, stretching, heat-setting and cooling zones by panel seams;
the front third is cut open to reveal two endless chain rails diverging in a V shape, with clip
units gripping both edges of a wide translucent film web that becomes progressively wider as it
travels; a chain tensioning unit and clip-opener at the entry end.
Accent color: violet (#7A5AF8) on the oven door handles and the chain-rail covers, occupying less
than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same tenter frame drawn as a patent-style line diagram — long insulated oven with
zone divisions and recirculation fans, front section cut open showing two diverging endless chain
rails, clip units gripping a widening film web, chain tensioner and clip opener at entry; internal
air ducts in dashed lines.
machines.extra_negative: tunnel kiln, conveyor belt oven, baking oven, greenhouse frame

machines.note: 段 6 · 橙红。`O-shaped gantry straddling the film path` 是识别点（O 型架）。注意 `with a horizontal scanning beam across the top and bottom`——上下都有梁，才是扫描仪不是门框。标注名：**Online Thickness Scanner / 在线测厚扫描架**。
machines.subject_3d:
an online thickness scanning gauge built as a rigid O-shaped gantry: two vertical
support columns bolted to floor plates, a horizontal top beam and a matching bottom beam forming
a closed O-frame that straddles the film path, a compact sensor head riding on the top beam with
a small bellows and a cable chain, a second sensor housing on the bottom beam aligned with it, a
local control box mounted on one column.
Accent color: orange-red (#E4572E) on the beam end caps and the sensor head housing, occupying
less than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same O-frame scanner drawn as a patent-style line diagram — two support columns,
top and bottom horizontal beams forming a closed O-frame, scanning sensor head on the top beam,
matching sensor housing below, cable chain, local control box.
machines.extra_negative: security gate, door frame, airport metal detector, portal scanner

machines.note: 段 6 · 橙红。和 D09 长得很像，靠三处拉开：**没有下梁**、`two line-scan camera housings with lens barrels`、`low-angle linear LED light bar`（掠射光源）。提示词里刻意写 "no bottom beam"，是为了让两张图一眼能区分。标注名：**Surface Defect Inspection / 表面瑕疵检测**。
machines.subject_3d:
a machine-vision surface inspection station, no bottom beam: two rectangular line-scan
camera housings with protruding lens barrels and finned heat sinks, mounted side by side on a
rigid cross beam above the film path and aimed downward; two long linear LED light bars set at a
low grazing angle, one on each side of the cameras; an industrial PC cabinet with ventilation
grilles standing beside the frame; cable chains running along the beam.
Accent color: orange-red (#E4572E) on the camera housing edges and the light-bar brackets,
occupying less than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same inspection station drawn as a patent-style line diagram — single cross beam
on two columns, two line-scan camera housings with lens barrels and heat sinks, two low-angle
linear light bars, industrial PC cabinet, cable chains; no bottom beam.
machines.extra_negative: security camera pole, floodlight rig, solar panel mount

machines.note: 段 7 · 玫红。`one rubber-covered nip roll against a steel roll` + `a bowed spreading roll` 是关键差异点——有胶辊和弧形展平辊的才是牵引组，不是普通过辊架。`a pair of circular edge-trim knives` 说明这里在切边。标注名：**Pull-Roll Unit / 牵引辊组**。
machines.subject_3d:
a film haul-off pull-roll unit: a compact fabricated frame carrying four chrome-plated
idler rolls in a staggered path, one rubber-covered nip roll pressed against a steel roll, one
bowed spreading roll, a pair of circular edge-trim knives mounted on a cross shaft with a small
trim-extraction hood, and a thin static-eliminator bar; a wide translucent film web threaded
through the rolls as a continuous sheet.
Accent color: rose-red (#D6438A) on the frame side plates and the knife-shaft guards, occupying
less than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same pull-roll unit drawn as a patent-style line diagram — staggered idler rolls,
rubber nip roll against a steel roll, bowed spreading roll, circular edge-trim knife pair with
extraction hood, static-eliminator bar, threaded film web.
machines.extra_negative: plain idler roller rack, conveyor pulley frame, wire straightener

machines.note: 段 7 · 玫红。识别点是 `two-position rotating turret carrying two winding shafts`（一个卷满、一个空着）。`large finished film roll about 1 m in diameter` 给了尺度参照，避免画成小卷轴。标注名：**Turret Winder / 转塔式收卷机**。
machines.subject_3d:
a turret-type film winder: a heavy two-position rotating turret carrying two parallel
winding shafts, one shaft loaded with a large finished film roll about 1 meter in diameter wound
on a paper core and the other empty with a bare chuck; a lay-on pressure roll riding against the
winding roll, a cut-off knife bar above it, a tension dancer roll upstream, and a tall drive
cabinet at the rear.
Accent color: rose-red (#D6438A) on the turret arms and the drive cabinet door, occupying less
than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same turret winder drawn as a patent-style line diagram — rotating turret with
two winding shafts, one loaded with a large film roll on a core, lay-on pressure roll, cut-off
knife bar, tension dancer roll, drive cabinet.
machines.extra_negative: cable reel stand, hose reel, small paper winder, spool holder

machines.note: 段 7 · 玫红。和收卷机容易混，靠 `a shaft with multiple circular shear slitting blades`（一排圆刀）+ `several narrow finished rolls of equal diameter`（多卷同径成品）区分。这两个特征一出现，就是分切机而不是收卷机。标注名：**Slitter Rewinder / 分切机**。
machines.subject_3d:
a film slitter rewinder: a robust frame with an unwinding shaft carrying one large master
roll at the left, an edge-guide assembly with a sensor fork, a slitting shaft fitted with multiple
circular shear blades and small trim-extraction hoods, and a dual-position rewinding station at
the right holding four narrow finished rolls of equal diameter on separate shafts; dancer rolls
and a control pedestal in front.
Accent color: rose-red (#D6438A) on the frame side panels and the control pedestal, occupying
less than 10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same slitter rewinder drawn as a patent-style line diagram — unwinding shaft with
master roll, edge-guide sensor fork, slitting shaft with multiple circular shear blades and trim
hoods, dual rewinding station with four equal-diameter finished rolls, dancer rolls, control
pedestal.
machines.extra_negative: single-shaft shredder, paper guillotine, log splitter

machines.note: 辅 · 灰。放在总图左下角，不占 7 段主线。`water-ring die-face pelletizer with a spinning blade` 是造粒机的标志性部件，不写就成了普通粉碎机。标注名：**Edge-Trim Granulator / 边料造粒机**。
machines.subject_3d:
a compact edge-trim film recycling granulator: a sound-insulated cutting chamber with a
top-mounted film-trim intake chute, a small single-screw extruder barrel underneath with heating
bands, a water-ring die-face pelletizer with a spinning blade and a short water trough, and a
small cyclone separator with a collection bin; a pneumatic conveying pipe with a blower connecting
the intake to the trim source.
Accent color: neutral grey (#6B7280) on the frame and the control box, occupying less than 10% of
the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same granulator drawn as a patent-style line diagram — cutting chamber with intake
chute, screw extruder barrel with heating bands, water-ring die-face pelletizer with spinning
blade, water trough, cyclone and collection bin, conveying pipe and blower.
machines.extra_negative: wood chipper, plastic shredder, hammer mill

machines.note: 辅 · 灰。导热油炉 + 冷冻水机组 + 干空气机组三件套拼在一个撬块上。`horizontal thermal-oil heater package with burner` 和 `packaged water chiller with two axial fans on top` 是各自识别点。标注名：**Utility Skid / 公用工程机组**（后期可在图下拆三个小标：Thermal Oil / Chiller / Air Dryer）。
machines.subject_3d:
a utility skid group mounted on one common steel skid: a horizontal thermal-oil heater
package with a burner assembly at one end, an expansion tank and a circulation pump; a packaged
water chiller with two axial fans on top and a louvered compressor compartment; a pair of
desiccant air-dryer columns with filters and pressure gauges; all interconnected by short
insulated pipes with isolation valves.
Accent color: neutral grey (#6B7280) on the skid frame and the control boxes, occupying less than
10% of the visible surface; the housing stays matte white.
machines.subject_line:
same utility skid drawn as a patent-style line diagram — thermal-oil heater with
burner, expansion tank and pump; packaged chiller with two axial fans; two desiccant dryer columns
with filters and gauges; common skid with interconnecting pipes and valves.
machines.extra_negative: shipping container, generator enclosure, HVAC rooftop unit
